about: Games allowed a network their slot's rule would hold back (src/tv_channels.py, Stage 15). Each entry names ONE game by its elias id (= nflverse old_game_id), the network it is excused for, why, and a source a person can open. An exception is for that network only: a game flexed to another network is checked again. Add entries in a reviewed PR, never by hand on main.
